title: Sasol brings Turbodiesel ULS 10ppm to the Western Cape
summary: Johannesburg, South Africa - Sasol is expanding access to its premium diesel offering with the rollout of Sasol Turbodiesel ULS 10ppm across 20 participating retail sites in the Western Cape, making one of the cleanest diesel grades available in South Africa more accessible to motorists in the province. The rollout forms part of Sasol’s ongoing commitment to providing customers with high-quality mobility solutions and helping them make informed fuel choices for their vehicles.
body_markdown:
# Overview


Through proprietary technologies and processes the main products Sasol produces are fuel components, chemical components and co-products. From these main products and further value-adding processes we deliver diesel, petrol (gasoline), naphtha, kerosene (jet fuel), liquid petroleum gas (LPG), olefins, alcohols, polymers, solvents, surfactants, co-monomers, ammonia, methanol, crude tar acids, sulphur, illuminating paraffin, bitumen and fuel oil. Even further processing produces numerous additional products.
